Emergency Description:
I am seeking an emergency loan of £10,000 due to an unexpected medical emergency. I was recently diagnosed with a serious medical condition and require immediate medical treatment, which is not covered by my health insurance. The treatment costs are estimated to be £12,000, and I have already arranged for a loan of £2,000 from a family member.

Financial Impact:
The emergency has had a significant financial impact on my family as I have had to take time off work to undergo the medical treatment. I have also had to pay for additional expenses such as transportation and medication. My monthly expenses are £3,000, and I have £5,000 in savings.

Repayment Plan:
I plan to repay the loan over a period of 24 months. I will make monthly payments of £500, which is affordable based on my monthly income and expenses. I have attached my most recent bank statements and payslips to support my application.

Declaration:
I declare that the information provided in this loan application is true and accurate to the best of my knowledge. I understand that providing false or misleading information may result in the rejection of my loan application or legal action.

Signature: John Doe
Date: 01/01/2023
